title: Billy: as-built path vs A5 at 7200 souls (strategy test, complete path states)
question: For Billy (billy_damage) between 2400 and 19200 souls: does the as-built path (Melee Lifesteal...; Cultist Sacrifice at 6400; vitality 4.8k at 9600) let Billy play more effectively than data-generated alternatives?
hypothesis: A0 AS-BUILT has the best time-averaged trade ratio (1-20 min, income-fed walk) in >=80% of the parameter grid; refuted if another path wins >=80% with >=3% median margin, undecided otherwise
tradeoffs: A5 vs A0 (equal souls, mean over checkpoints): HP +7%, heal/trade -12%, damage to heroes -6%, clear speed -7%; trade ratio better at [4800, 7200, 9600, 12000, 14400, 16800, 19200], worse at none
missing_evidence: clear speed/camp hp/soul values: no NPC or camp data in the sandbox or vdata (needs a camp-clear scenario per checkpoint, generic_camp_clear)
enemy poke/burst curve: reference enemy is ASSUMED (needs shoot-back mode / real lane logs)
trade->income link (beta), forced-back and death costs: ASSUMED (needs match data: souls vs lane trade outcome)
hit rate on heroes and melee uptime: ASSUMED ranges (needs streak-accuracy sandbox runs or replays)
enemy CC not modelled (GAPS 7): escapes and channels valued without silence/stun; anti-heal only as the grid parameter antiheal

model structure (not in the grid): 1v1 trade ratio TTD/TTK rewards balanced health and damage by construction; teamfight focus, burst before healing lands, positioning, objectives and item actives timing are not modelled; resource-gated cards assume card_stored

model-wide pattern (sweep of all 81 data.js builds, quick grid, 2026-10-24): the as-built path won 0 grid cells on any build and 1-2 cheap defensive greens before the spike item won 51 of 57 decided builds; either the Council builds under-buy early sustain in general or the 1v1 trade-ratio model over-values cheap health. Settle with a shoot-back lane test (GAPS 6/17) at one checkpoint before trusting a single-build verdict

unpriced item effects: Berserker: on-hit/stack effect not priced; Crushing Fists: on-hit/stack effect not priced; Cultist Sacrifice: +1 ability charge and range/radius of the buff not priced; buff stats x uptime Cultist Sacrifice 0.59; Silencer: on-hit/stack effect not priced
melee semantics: Lifestrike cooldown not in data (8 s ASSUMED), Blasted melee bonus health per hit (field-name reading), Bashdown counting as melee for item procs (UNVERIFIED)

arms.name: A0
arms.notes: complete A0 state at the checkpoint (strategy file)

setup.level_or_boons: abil bits from the strategy file tiers at the checkpoint
setup.position: shoot-back lane trade (GAPS 6/17 ops needed): enemy Haze bot 350u firing back

enemies.items: reference enemy at the same souls

controls: real ability tiers at the checkpoint (no unlock-all)
procedure: trade 8 s with the shoot-back enemy, measure damage dealt, damage taken, healing, HP left

metrics.name: trade_ratio
metrics.how: time-to-die / time-to-kill from the measured damage rates

metrics.name: net_hp_per_cycle
metrics.how: HP after rest minus HP before trade

decision.rule: SUPPORTS the strategy file if A5 beats A0 by >=5% with non-overlapping ranges; REFUTES if reverse; else INCONCLUSIVE
